package.name: ichava/icon-sets-twemoji
package.title: Twemoji
package.description: Twemoji, Twitter/X's open-source emoji set, as SVG. Twemoji 15, on the Unicode emoji 16.0 taxonomy. Categorised by Unicode CLDR groups. OpenMoji is in ichava/icon-sets-openmoji.

twemoji.name: Twemoji
twemoji.description: Twitter/X's open-source emoji set (CC-BY 4.0). Recognisable rounded colourful style. Default set.

upstream._comment: Each emoji set has its own upstream; Twemoji is the only one.

source._why_npm: NPM publishes new Twemoji releases the same day as GitHub but with no rate-limit ceiling and a simpler API contract.

update_command._note: Refresh runs in ichava/icon-sets-sync via the `twemoji-sets` recipe -- Twemoji (npm) + Unicode CLDR. No pack-side script.

upstream._vendored_note: Versions of the upstreams that produced the shipped assets. They move independently and conflating them is what left this pack empty: current_version read 17.0.0, which @twemoji/svg has never published, so `npm pack` failed and no assets were ever written (V4). Twemoji 15.0.0 is npm's latest; Unicode emoji 16.0 is the newest emoji-test.txt that exists and is what the CLDR categorisation used. The jdecked/twemoji repository tags independently of the npm package: npm's 15.0.0 has no v15.0.0 tag, only v15.1.0. `twemoji_github_raw` therefore carries `{twemoji_github_tag}` rather than `{version}` -- a caller substituting only `{version}` leaves a visible placeholder in the URL instead of building a plausible v15.0.0 that 404s.
